# Paths a PR labelled "post-merge-review" must not touch.
#
# A labelled PR fails the "post-merge-review paths" check if ANY changed file
# (both names of a rename) matches a line below; such a PR keeps the full
# review before merge. Without the label the check passes and nothing changes.
#
# One bash glob per line, matched against the repo-relative path; "*" also
# matches "/". Blank lines and text after "#" are ignored. The check reads
# this file from the base branch, so a PR cannot loosen its own check.

# The check itself and CI.
.github/post-merge-review-deny.txt
.github/scripts/*
.github/workflows/*

# Data path and replication.
core/storage/*
core/frontend/*
core/transport/*
core/replication/*
core/recovery/*
core/engine/*
core/adapter/*

# Authority: lease, epoch, fencing, move.
core/authority/*
core/host/master/workspace_*
core/host/volume/workspace_lease*
cmd/blockvolume/workspace_lease*

# Wire and persisted formats.
*.proto
*.pb.go
core/host/master/journal_isolation*
core/lifecycle/store*
cmd/sparrow/persist*

# GC and delete paths.
cmd/sw-block/chunk_gc*
cmd/sw-block/chunk_volume_delete*
core/lifecycle/deletion_reservations*
core/ops/delete_safety_contract*

# Lease, epoch, claim, admission, GC, delete or format code wherever it lives,
# by file name.
*/lease*.go
*_lease*.go
*epoch*.go
*fenc*.go
*claim*.go
*admission*.go
*/gc[_.]*
*_gc[_.]*
*delet*.go
*purge*.go
*persist*.go
*journal*.go
*format*.go
